quest.title: Eat and Learn
quest.description: The foodie researcher Jafar is still studying "eating" today...
quest.rewards_formatted: Delicious Minty Bean Soup x1, Delicious Panipuri x1, Delicious Shawarma Wrap x1

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: You seem to be in a rush, my friend. What's bothering you?

response.speaker: Jafar
response.text: Ah... Indeed, I can see that you are tired and pressed for time.

response.speaker: Jafar
response.text: You must have something on your mind that needs to be resolved as soon as possible.

response.speaker: Jafar
response.text: Rather than rushing about, I'd like to invite you to have a delicious meal with me if you are willing to wait but a little while.

response.speaker: Jafar
response.text: Haste is indeed a normal part of life, yes... but as we often put it, even a raging river must sometimes flow peacefully through a serene stream.

response.speaker: Jafar
response.text: You must take a little break every now and then.

response.speaker: Jafar
response.text: Hmmm...

response.speaker: Jafar
response.text: Why don't we enjoy some Minty Bean Soup together?

response.speaker: Jafar
response.text: You don't have to pay me any Mora. Just help me find a sprig of Mint.

response.speaker: Jafar
response.text: Ah, yes — and don't be too picky when you search for that mint sprig.

response.speaker: Jafar
response.text: Remember, you are just looking for a regular sprig. You aren't looking for troubles of any kind.

response.speaker: Jafar
response.text: Oh, that's good, that's good.

response.speaker: Jafar
response.text: Still, your steps are hurried. You seek to fix some problem or another, perhaps?

response.speaker: Jafar
response.text: Well, I don't know what problem it is that you seek to solve, but I have a suggestion...

talks.objective: Give the cooking ingredient to Jafar

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: Please find me <color=#00E1FFFF>a sprig of Mint</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: That is an excellent sprig of Mint, indeed! Now, please wait here a while.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: This is the Minty Bean Soup, made with the ingredients you brought. Please help yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: My pleasure. Enjoy your meal!

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: To me, eating means leaving all my exhausting work and research behind for a time...

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: I let my mind flow peacefully through that serene stream... this is how I relax.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: Well, enjoy your meal to the fullest. I hope that it can also put your mind at ease.
